crew.overview: France, 1914, during World War I. On Christmas Eve, an extraordinary event takes place in the bloody no man's land that the French and the Scots dispute with the Germans…
crew.title: Joyeux Noel

details.biography: Andreea She was born in Romania and move to USA in 2006. Andreea has a calm, positive and professional attitude. She works closely with both actors and directors to form a creative relationship based on trust. She is a highly experienced, multi skilled Make-up Designer in the TV, Film Industry, Theatre and Fashion. She specializes in Prosthetics, Period and modern Make-up and has over 20 years experience. She is fun, versatile, confident and reliable in all areas of Hair, Make-up and Prosthetics. Due to her passion, enthusiasm and commitment towards her work, Andreea is able to work effectively under pressure and to agreed deadlines wishlist delivering high standards. Andreea's approachable personality and multi-skills makes her both a committed team member and leader. She has experience working throughout the world including: United States, UK, Romania, Qatar and Switzerland.
details.name: Andrea Dardea Tesdall
